move: giant word settles letter by letter, polaroids drop with spin, sweep out
how: A dark stage with a 330px CONFIG word in dim grey rising letter by letter (yPercent 40, opacity 0, expo.out 0.8s, 50ms stagger). Five white-bordered polaroid photos at fixed positions drop in every 0.5s from 8%: each comes from scale 1.6, y -80 and +25deg over its seeded rest rotation, landing with back.out(1.4) over 0.75s, then drifts slightly (y and +/-2deg, sine.inOut 1.6s) while holding. A tag line rises from a mask at 20%. At 77% the photos sweep up out of frame (y -800, -20deg, expo.in 0.55s, 120ms stagger), the tag drops out and the letters lift away.
adapt: Replace the word letters, the five photo images, captions and positions/sizes, and the rng seed for tilt. Keep the 0.75s back.out(1.4) landing, 0.5s cadence and the 120ms sweep stagger.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the big word spans and the polaroids inside el with seeded rotations. animate(el, shot, D) returns the same timeline with drops at 0.083+i*0.083 of D and the exit at 0.77 of D.
caveats: from() tweens need immediateRender:false when built late
